evidence_quotes: 27 seismic events were recorded across Indonesia between 2026-01-17 and 2026-02-16, with Tobelo leading activity at 19 events and Tual accounting for the remaining 8.
a magnitude 5.5 event on 2026-01-27 at 30 km E of Tual, with a shallow depth of only 5.4 km, is the sole event in the digest carrying a tsunami flag
the period's largest event — a magnitude 5.7 at 152.9 km depth near Tobelo
depths spanning from 3.3 km to 195.8 km
a magnitude 4.8 at 2.0 km near Tual on the same date
criticisms: Minor: The report states depths 'spanning from 3.3 km to 195.8 km' for Tobelo events. The 195.8 km depth is confirmed (2026-01-17 event at Tobelo), and 3.3 km is confirmed (2026-02-14 event at 44 km E of Tobelo). This is accurate.
Minor: The report says '2 events on 2026-01-27' — the digest daily_counts shows 2 events on 2026-01-27, which is correct.
Minor: The report says '2 events on 2026-01-31' — the digest daily_counts confirms 2 events on 2026-01-31, which is correct.

The report notes the digest provides 'only 27 sample events' and questions whether this is a complete set or subset. The digest summary event_count is 27 and sample_events contains all 27 events, so this is actually the complete set — a slight mischaracterization, though appropriately cautious rather than fabricated.
No material factual errors or hallucinated data found. All magnitudes, depths, dates, tsunami flags, place names, and counts are directly traceable to the source digest.
